reviews.title: Do NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: Every once in a great while the “talent” will put in a worth while effort. That is an extreme rarity and the app third party service does not care how terrible the quality of their products are. Do not waste your money here. You will absolutely regret it.

reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text: I ordered a video from Lavar Ball as a gift for my Cousins birthday. He completely ignored my prompt and spent the whole time talking about himself. I wanted to ask for a redo but he charges another $20 just to message him. Contacted customer service and they wouldn’t request a redo or refund me, thats $150 i will never get back. This app a ripoff spend your money somewhere else

reviews.title: Doesn’t convert USD to correct GBP exchange rate
reviews.text: Though a great idea and I have had great videos and messages from the celeb of my choice there is an issue with currency conversion to GBP resulting in overcharge. I have contacted Apple as suggested who say it is an in app bug from cameo and cameo customer service has been exceptionally poor. I should have been immediately credited the overcharge (of almost £200) which so know they are capable of and the bug should be fixed so the prices match the desktop site. Blaming Apple Pay and ignoring me simply isn’t good enough!

reviews.title: Absolute joke!!
reviews.text: I spent just over £80 to request a video from christi from dance moms for my partner. In the request I asked for a small pep talk and pick me up for her. The video I got in return was just disgusting! I was given a 17 second video of a pub. With a ship in a bottle without the Christie’s face and voice nowhere to be seen. It’s theft at most. Don’t waste your time. Unbelievable

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: I paid for a video for my sons birthday from one of his favorite athletes and I get an email the day of his birthday saying “sorry, but your request expired” then they hold your funds for 5-7 days, no “sorry this happened, but here’s a credit for a faster video since your guy ignored it” or nothing. Just screwed and no time to recover. I won’t use it again.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: I had bought a cameo, and for the whole process it just said “in progress” after 7 days it still had not come. Following this I tried contacting the customer tram as it still said in progress and got 0 correspondence about my refund or the status of the order. RIDICULOUSLY BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE!

reviews.title: Overcharged. Be careful.
reviews.text: Ordered a Cameo today and the price in USD is $38.90 which in GBP should be about £28.50. I’ve been charged £39.90. Be aware!
